ChiSiamo.title: About Us
ChiSiamo.subtitle: A passion for collecting excellence.
ChiSiamo.storyP1: Kudjo was born from the need to rise above the chaos of generic online marketplaces and social media groups. We believe that high-value collectible cards deserve the same treatment, care, and presentation as luxury goods or fine art.
ChiSiamo.storyP2: We are not a mass-market comic book shop, nor an automated marketplace. Kudjo is a select independent dealer: we curate a tight archive of pieces whose provenance is known, inspect physical conditions minutely under controlled lighting, and offer an exclusive private negotiation channel.
ChiSiamo.visionP1: This catalog represents the MVP and foundation of our ecosystem. Our long-term vision is to evolve Kudjo into a highly specialized premium auction platform, where collectors can trade elite, pre-verified lots in safety and transparency.

Legal.title: Terms & Legal Notes
Legal.subtitle: Transparency and platform responsibility.
Legal.disclaimerP1: Kudjo operates exclusively as a digital catalog and showcase of physical lots, owned or on consignment. This site is NOT an e-commerce platform, does not contain online payment gateways (like Stripe or PayPal), and does not offer any integrated auction or bidding service in this version.
Legal.disclaimerP2: All negotiations, sales agreements, financial transactions, and shipping occur privately, outside of the website infrastructure, via direct agreements between the buyer and the dealer (Kudjo). Kudjo disclaims all liability for payment methods chosen privately by the parties.
Legal.privacyP1: Data collected through contact forms (name, email, phone number) is used solely to respond to inquiries or purchase requests submitted by the user. We do not sell or share data with third parties.
